action_items.item: JRN-16 CMS draft/publish not exercised: publishing text to the live home page would modify seeded/user CMS content (fixture discipline). Needs human verification or a tscheck-scoped CMS block.

JRN-8 exact DST dates (Mar/Oct 2026) are in the past (server date 2026-11-08) and 2027 equivalents are beyond maxBookingHorizonDays=60; only the winter CET offset (local->UTC) was verified. Human verification of summer/DST transitions needed.

Backend tests authenticate by inserting tscheck-sess-* rows into the session collection for the existing test accounts (no account changed). Residue: tscheck- appointments, clients, contact messages, subscribers, media assets.
